title: Group consolidation
intro: Each plant reports its own figure. Subsidiaries consolidate their plants by equity share, and the group consolidates its subsidiaries. The approved group value is what flows into the report.
pickQuestion: Choose a disclosure to see its consolidation
pickHint: Pick a disclosure from the list to see how each entity rolls up into the group total.

fullyApproved.title: Every entity is approved for this disclosure
fullyApproved.body: The consolidated group value will populate the next report.

empty.noEntitiesBody: Add the group, subsidiaries and plants first; consolidation follows the entity tree.
empty.noQuestionsBody: Enable the framework and assign its disclosures to see group totals here.

scope.title: Consolidated emissions by scope
scope.subtitle: Group total · {{unit}} · equity-weighted
scope.emptyBody: Totals appear once plants submit Scope 1, 2 or 3 values.
scope.footnote: Includes submitted, reviewed and approved values. Select a bar to open that disclosure.

table.footnote: Reported is the entity's own figure; consolidated adds its children and applies the equity share. Exact values — no rounding.
